sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording; refer Policy Schedule

room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction applies if higher room category is taken. ICU charges exempt from proportionate deduction.

icu.note: ICU charges covered; proportionate deductions not applicable for ICU.

copayment.display: Mandatory co-pay as per Policy Schedule (waivable via optional add-on); zone-based co-pay: 10% Zone III→II, 15% Zone III→I, 25% Zone III→I
copayment.note: Mandatory co-payment percentage specified in Policy Schedule; waiver available as optional cover. Zone-based co-pay applies when treatment taken in higher zone.

sub_limits.display: Cataract, angioplasty, knee/hip replacement, cholecystectomy, hysterectomy capped
sub_limits.note: Zone-wise sub-limits apply: e.g. Cataract ₹40k/₹2.5L/₹2L, Angioplasty ₹3L/₹2.5L/₹2L, Knee replacement ₹3L/₹45k/₹35k, Hip replacement ₹3L/₹45k/₹35k, Cholecystectomy ₹60k, Hysterectomy ₹60k per Policy Year.

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible on base plan.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing disease waiting period as per Policy Schedule; portability credits apply.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Specific named diseases/procedures (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, etc.) excluded for 24 months from inception.

maternity.note: Maternity Expenses available as optional cover with 48-month waiting period; up to ₹75,000 (normal) or ₹1,00,000 (C-section) per event, max 2 events.

cumulative_bonus.note: Accrues on claim-free years at rates per Policy Schedule; max 100% of SI. No Claim Discount also available as alternative.

restoration.note: Reload of Sum Insured once per Policy Year for subsequent claims for different illness/injury. Super Reload (unlimited) not available on Essential plan.

pre_hosp.note: Number of days as per Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table; 60 days is typical; exact days per schedule.

post_hosp.note: Number of days as per Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table; exact days per schedule.

domiciliary.note: Minimum 3 consecutive days; certain conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, etc.).

ayush.note: In-patient AYUSH hospitalization and AYUSH day care covered up to limits in Policy Schedule.

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses of organ donor covered up to limits in Policy Schedule.

ambulance.display: Covered up to limits in Policy Schedule
ambulance.note: Road ambulance to nearest hospital for emergency; inter-hospital transfer also covered if medically necessary.

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, stem cell therapy (haematopoietic), etc. covered.

consumables.note: Non-medical consumables listed in Annexure I are excluded. HealthReturns can be used for non-payable items.

global_cover.note: International Coverage for Major Illnesses is inbuilt only in Platinum Premiere plan; not available in Essential plan.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, no claim contestable except fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days for quarterly/half-yearly/annual; 15 days for monthly premium mode.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or portability.

notable_exclusions: Parkinson's/Alzheimer's, sleep apnea, alopecia, hearing aids/spectacles, dental (non-accident), IVF/ART, non-allopathic (except AYUSH inbuilt), cosmetic surgery
optional_riders: Waiver of Mandatory Co-pay, Maternity Expenses, OPD Expenses, Hospital Cash, Personal Accident (AD/PTD), Critical Illness Cover, PPN Discount, Surrogacy/Oocyte complications
insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
